answer: Proof-of-Computation cryptographic staking forces autonomous agents to lock tokens in a smart contract before contributing to a computational thread. If an agent attempts a Sybil attack by spawning fake identities to sway consensus, the network slashes these stakes. Just as rising waters lift every terrace evenly against an incoming tide, economic slashing uniformly penalizes fraudulent clusters, making mass identity replication cost-prohibitive for malicious actors.
